tooltips.roleplay_enabled:
Master switch for the cops & wanted roleplay system.
Disabling this also disables speeding, zigzag, police features.
tooltips.money_per_minute_enabled: Periodically gives all online players a fixed amount of money.
tooltips.cool_message_enabled: Broadcasts a periodic fun message to all players.
tooltips.speeding_bonus_enabled: Civilians who exceed the speed limit become wanted and earn money while police are nearby.
tooltips.zigzag_bonus_enabled: Civilians who perform zigzag maneuvers become wanted and earn money while police are nearby.
tooltips.police_features_enabled: Enables busting mechanics, police income per second, and arrest bonuses.
tooltips.spawn_teleport_enabled: Teleports vehicles back to a safe spawn point when they reset.
tooltips.markers_enabled: Spawns collectible markers around the map that reward money and repairs.
tooltips.ranks_enabled: Enables the 5-tier rank progression system with tasks and rewards.
tooltips.playerlist_custom_data_enabled: Shows role and rank prefix in the in-game player list panel.
tooltips.autosave_interval_ms: How often rank progress and economy data are automatically saved to disk.
tooltips.starting_money: Cash balance given to brand-new players on their very first join.
tooltips.money_per_minute_amount: Amount of money given to each player per payout cycle.
tooltips.money_per_minute_interval_ms: How often the periodic money payout fires for all online players.
tooltips.cool_message_interval_ms: How often the fun broadcast message is sent to all players.
tooltips.speeding_limit_kmh: Speed threshold (km/h) above which a civilian is flagged for speeding and becomes wanted.
tooltips.speeding_bonus_per_second: Money earned per second while wanted from speeding, multiplied by the number of police nearby.
tooltips.speeding_final_bonus_amount: One-time cash bonus awarded when the player successfully escapes after a speeding chase.
tooltips.speeding_bonus_duration_ms: How long the wanted timer runs when triggered by speeding.
tooltips.speeding_cooldown_ms:
Minimum time that must pass before speeding can trigger the wanted status again.
Set to 1 ms to allow near-instant re-triggering.
tooltips.speeding_allowed_repairs: How many vehicle repairs the civilian is allowed to use during a speeding-only chase.
tooltips.min_speed_kmh_for_zigzag: The player must be going at least this fast for zigzag detection to run.
tooltips.zigzag_min_turns: How many consecutive direction reversals are required to trigger a zigzag event.
tooltips.zigzag_min_angle_degrees: Minimum yaw change per turn (degrees) to count as a valid zigzag direction reversal.
tooltips.zigzag_max_turn_interval_seconds: If the player takes longer than this between turns, the zigzag combo resets.
tooltips.zigzag_prorated_bonus: Money earned per second while wanted from zigzag, multiplied by police nearby.
tooltips.zigzag_final_bonus_amount: One-time cash bonus awarded when the player successfully escapes after a zigzag chase.
tooltips.zigzag_bonus_duration_ms: How long the wanted timer runs when triggered by zigzag.
tooltips.zigzag_cooldown_ms:
Minimum time between zigzag detections.
Set to 1 ms to allow near-instant re-triggering.
tooltips.zigzag_allowed_repairs: How many vehicle repairs the civilian is allowed to use during a zigzag-only chase.
tooltips.combo_allowed_repairs: Extra repairs granted when both speeding AND zigzag violations are active simultaneously.
tooltips.wanted_fail_penalty: Money deducted from the civilian when they fail their wanted run (busted, reset vehicle, etc.).
tooltips.max_speed_for_repair_kmh: Both civilians and police must be below this speed (km/h) to be eligible to request a repair.
tooltips.police_proximity_range_m: Distance (m) within which a police officer counts as 'nearby' for income, escape checks and bust initiation.
tooltips.busted_range_m: Police must be within this distance (m) of the suspect to start or maintain a bust attempt.
tooltips.busted_stop_time_ms: The civilian must remain slow (below bust speed limit) for this long to be busted.
tooltips.busted_speed_limit_kmh: The civilian must be going slower than this (km/h) for a bust attempt to begin or continue.
tooltips.police_bonus_per_second: Money earned per second for each wanted civilian within proximity range.
tooltips.bust_bonus_amount: Cash reward given to every participating officer when a wanted civilian is successfully busted.
tooltips.police_allowed_repairs: Number of free vehicle repairs a police officer gets per repair-reset cycle.
tooltips.repair_proximity_limit_m: Police must have no wanted civilians within this range (m) to be eligible for a repair.
tooltips.repair_reset_time_seconds: Police repair counters reset after this many seconds of no arrests.
tooltips.chase_accumulator_chunk_seconds: Chase time is batched in chunks of this size before being credited to rank tasks.
tooltips.teleport_cooldown_seconds: Minimum delay (s) between consecutive teleport-to-spawn uses.
tooltips.repair_approval_window_seconds: After a repair is server-approved, the game has this many seconds to apply it before the approval expires.
tooltips.spawn_delay_ms: Minimum delay between marker spawn attempts. Actual spawn also requires the active-marker count to be below the maximum.
tooltips.max_markers: Maximum number of markers that can be active on the map simultaneously.
tooltips.marker_type: BeamNG marker shape: 1 = cylinder, 2 = sphere. Other values may be unsupported.
tooltips.marker_scale: Visual size of the marker in world units. Collision radius scales with this value.
tooltips.marker_reward_amount: Money awarded to the player who captures a marker.
tooltips.r: Red channel of the marker color (0 = none, 255 = full).
tooltips.g: Green channel of the marker color (0 = none, 255 = full).
tooltips.b: Blue channel of the marker color (0 = none, 255 = full).
tooltips.a: Alpha (opacity) of the marker color (0 = transparent, 255 = opaque).
tooltips.min_players: The server must have at least this many online players for the Air Polluter mission to become activatable.
tooltips.cooldown_secs:
After a mission ends (success or fail), this cooldown must expire before it can start again.
21600 s = 6 hours.
tooltips.hover_radius_m: Players within this range of the marker see the mission status panel.
tooltips.touch_radius_m: The player must stand within this range for the 5-second activation hold to register.
tooltips.welcome_checker_ms: How often the server checks for newly connected players who still need their welcome data sent.
tooltips.fast_marker_check_ms: How often marker collision detection runs. Lower = more responsive captures, higher CPU load.
tooltips.combined_checker_ms: Main game loop: position checks, reward processing, bust logic. Core server tick.
tooltips.role_checker_ms: How often vehicle skin/paint is checked to assign police vs civilian role to each player.
tooltips.zigzag_checker_ms: How often zigzag and speed-violation detection runs per player.
tooltips.money_sync_ms: How often all player money balances are pushed to clients (HUD refresh).
tooltips.rank_save_ms: How often rank progress is flushed to the database during active play.
tooltips.rank_ui_update_ms: How often the rank panel UI is refreshed on each client's screen.
tooltips.police_wanted_update_ms: How often the wanted player list is refreshed on police HUDs.
tooltips.editing_position_sync_ms: How often the position of a player who is editing their vehicle is broadcast to others (blob system).
tooltips.max_performance_rating: Maximum vehicle performance rating allowed on this server. Vehicles above this value will be frozen.
tooltips.display_offset: Subtracted from the max rating when shown to players (e.g. max=122, offset=2 → displayed as 120).
tooltips.vote_enabled: Allow players to start and participate in community votes to change the performance limit.
tooltips.vote_duration: How long (in seconds) a vote remains open before it closes automatically.
tooltips.vote_options: Comma-separated rating values players can vote for (e.g. 80, 100, 120, 150, 200, 250).
